title: 4C Presenting Yourself — Идиомы: самопрезентация и собеседования

items.example: In an interview you must sell yourself in two minutes.
She put her best foot forward and got the job.
There is a fine line between presenting yourself and singing your own praises.
He tooted his own horn through the whole interview.

items.idiom: fake it till you make it
items.example: Nervous? Fake it till you make it — smile and breathe.
For the sales job, dress for success, not for a party.
Tough questions test whether you can think on your feet.
He kept his cool when asked about his lack of experience.
A short story about your first job breaks the ice.
Steer the talk to topics that play to your strengths.
She clearly knows her stuff in programming.
The role is a perfect fit for your skills.
Candidates often talk themselves up — give examples instead.
